title: A context manager that always releases the lock

concepts.description: @contextmanager turns a generator with a single yield into a context manager: code before the yield is setup, code after is teardown.
concepts.context: exclusive_lock in migrate.py takes the lock before the yield and releases it after

concepts.description: A finally block runs whether the body returns, raises or is interrupted, so a resource is released on every path.
concepts.context: the finally in exclusive_lock unlocks even if apply_pending raises

concepts.description: flock takes an advisory lock on a file descriptor that cooperating processes respect; it does nothing to a process that never asks.
concepts.context: fcntl.flock(handle, LOCK_EX) in migrate.py serialises concurrent migration runs on /tmp/migrate.lock
